text:
Tara: heads-up i'm iterating on the new quickstart  goal is a super-short path to first deploy + clear auth story. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4490
Noah: nice. what's changing?
Tara: 1) tiny 'Before you begin' with REDWOOD_TOKEN + PROJECT_REGION 2) switch browser example to ephemeral tokens 3) short troubleshooting FAQ for first-deploy errors
Ivy: love the checklist. for ephemeral example please show the SDK pinned version and clarify ttl units.
Tara: planned snippet:
```js
// pinned to @redwood/sdk@^8.1.0
const token = await client.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttl: 60 }) // ttl in seconds
await fetch('/api/deploy', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
```
Noah: tiny nit: use `ttl` not `ttlSeconds` so it reads quickly. also add one-line caveat: "Not for production; see /guides/security".
doc-bot: link-checker: found broken link -> /guides/auth-old (404)
Tara: thanks, replaced with /guides/auth-overview and pushed.
Luis: CI flagged eslint no-console in the sample app. either use `logger.info` or add `// eslint-disable-next-line` on that line.
Tara: i'll swap to logger. also updating screenshots (env var label changed to REDWOOD_TOKEN).
Noah: add a one-line note about PROJECT_REGION causing silent deploy failures; saved us many support tickets.
Tara: added a "Common gotchas" bullet with PROJECT_REGION + clock-skew check for 401s.
Ivy: LGTM once screenshot is updated and CI is green.
Tara: pushing screenshot and lint fix now, will ping when CI passes :rocket:
